composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. creative_direction: Create a red apple crossed by a short arched pencil bridge. The pencil is plain and unbranded, bending through a clean tunnel in the apple rather than piercing it. Show a small open gap under the arch and a single leaf near the stem. Use broad matte shapes, one warm highlight plane, and a pale cream background. Keep the object compact without tabletop clutter. Use clean surreal color-block illustration. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
